Name: Iddo, Son of Joah
Summary: Son of Joah and father of Zerah in Gershom's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:21: Son of Joah and father of Zerah in Gershom's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Iddo stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
